title: Your dossiers
description: Every visa application saved in this browser.

empty.title: No saved dossiers yet
empty.description: Start a dossier and it will be saved here automatically.

card.unreadableHint: This dossier was saved by a newer version of VisaFlow. It has not been deleted — update VisaFlow, or export it as a file from a version that can read it.

remove.title: Delete {{name}}?
remove.body: This permanently deletes this dossier from this browser. Any JSON file you already exported is unaffected. This cannot be undone.

status.errorHint: Your dossier is still open and nothing was lost, but this browser refused to store it. Export a JSON copy to be safe.
status.sessionOnlyHint: This dossier is not being saved. It disappears when you close or refresh the tab — export it to keep a copy.
status.unavailableHint: This browser will not let VisaFlow store data, so your dossier is kept in memory only. Export a JSON copy before closing the tab.

mode.saveHint: Kept in this browser so it is here when you come back. Never sent to a server.
mode.sessionHint: Nothing is written to this browser. Best on a shared or public computer.
